name: commerce-order-console
description: Browser-based console for creating, finding and fulfilling phone orders.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
